chapter.subject: Science
chapter.chapter: Chapter 8 — Measurement of Time and Motion

excerpts:
[INJSO 2014 — question paper]
65. A particle is moving on the real line, and its position is observed at four different
time stamps. At time t = 0, the particle is at x = 0, at time t = 20 seconds, we have
x = 40, at time t = 40 seconds, x = 60 and at time t = 60 seconds, we have x = 90.
Show that at some point of time between 0 and 60 seconds, the acceleration of the
particle was zero. [5 Marks]

[INJSO 2011 — question paper]
34. Velocity time graph of four athletes for a given interval of time are as given below. Who has
travelled maximum distance?
a) A b) B c) C d) D

[INJSO 2013 — question paper]
60. A 100 m sprinter increases her speed from rest uniformly at the rate of 1 m/s upto 2
40 m and covers the remaining distance with uniform speed. The sprinter covers the
first half of the run in t 1 s and the second half in t 2 s. Then:
A. t 1 > t 2
B. t < t 1 2
C. t = t 1 2
D. information given is incomplete.

[INJSO 2011 — question paper]
6. A ball is dropped from a height h on a floor and suffers multiple perfectly elastic bounces. The
velocity vs t graph is as shown. Here time T depicts the time required to complete one cycle.
Which of the following graph correctly shows the cumulative distance vs time?
